subject.title: Agent陷入工具调用失败死循环，导致重复发送消息刷屏

question: What default tool-failure loop policy should OpenClaw enforce for deterministic validation failures and repeated user-visible channel sends?
rationale: The current detector is intentionally opt-in and tests lock that default, while the reported failure needs a product decision on when core may block tool execution and what users see in chat.

options.title: Default conservative guard
options.body: Enable a narrow default guard for repeated deterministic failures and repeated identical no-progress sends, with structured one-message failure reporting and focused upgrade tests.

options.title: Keep opt-in only
options.body: Leave tools.loopDetection disabled by default and route this issue to docs or configuration guidance, accepting that default installs can still loop until a broader policy lands.

options.title: Split by failure class
options.body: Track validation-error classification, channel message de-duplication, and broader circuit breakers as separate product decisions before changing defaults.

recommendation.title: Default conservative guard
recommendation.body: Enable a narrow default guard for repeated deterministic failures and repeated identical no-progress sends, with structured one-message failure reporting and focused upgrade tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent agent runtime and tool-call correctness history makes this the best available owner for the default behavior and upgrade-safety decision.
